subject: Marketplace co-sell: Siemens demo — handoff bracket
messages:
From: Devon Park <devon.park@siemens-cloud.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Cc: marketplace-ops@siemens-cloud.com, sara.lin@si-systems.io
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Siemens x Redwood — co-sell demo window request

Hi Lauren,

Thanks for the intro earlier. Siemens would like to lock a demo window next week for our joint Marketplace listing review and ops handoff. Primary ask: walk through the listing, rehearse the failover flow (multi-region), and confirm recording & listing metadata. Target audience: Siemens cloud marketplace ops + two SI technical leads.

Availability: we have a tight maintenance window Fri 21st 16:00–20:00 CEST (preferred) but can also do an overnight bracket Thu->Fri 23:00 CEST–02:00 CEST if that helps Redwood/APac folks. Can you propose a run-of-show and who from Redwood should lead the ops section?

Thanks—Devon

--
Devon Park
Partner Programs, Siemens Industry Cloud
devon.park@siemens-cloud.com
+44 20 7946 0123
From: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
To: Devon Park <devon.park@siemens-cloud.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, olga_petrov@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 12:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Siemens x Redwood — co-sell demo window request

Hey Devon — great to hear.

We can own the marketplace listing walkthrough and will hand over ops to our SI enablement lead for the failover rehearsal. Two options that map to your windows:

- Fri 21 May 16:30–17:30 CEST (short weekday slot) — would focus on listing + quick failover demo (we'd record).
- Thu 20 May 23:00–01:00 CEST (overnight bracket) — deeper rehearsal with end-to-end failover and can include SI dry-run.

I've looped Vanessa (partnerships) and Karthik (SI enablement). Vanessa, can you confirm if the Marketplace listing review needs >30 mins of product narrative? Karthik / Olga — can you confirm who will drive the failover runbook and whether we need to provision a dedicated region mirror for the rehearsal?

Attachments: I attached a first-pass runbook and a draft agenda. Happy to iterate.

Best,
Lauren

--
Lauren Bishop
Partnerships Lead, Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com
From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, Devon Park <devon.park@siemens-cloud.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, olga_petrov@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Siemens x Redwood — co-sell demo window request

Lauren / Devon — quick note from partnerships ops: the listing narrative typically needs ~20–30 mins (customer-facing buyer value prop + screenshot walkthrough). If we go with the Fri late-afternoon slot, we should keep the agenda tight: 30m listing + 20m failover demo + 10m Q&A. For the overnight bracket, we'll expand: add SI dry-run and recording verification.

Logistics: 1) Recording will be uploaded to the Siemens marketplace doc; 2) We need a signoff on the metadata fields at least 48 hours prior. Devon, can you share who owns the marketplace metadata on your side?

Vanessa

--
Vanessa Ortiz
Partner Success, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: Devon Park <devon.park@siemens-cloud.com>, olga_petrov@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 08:11:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Siemens x Redwood — co-sell demo window request

Hi all — technical check from SI enablement. We can run the full failover in the overnight bracket and provision a temporary mirror in eu-west-1 for the rehearsal. Requirements:

- 2 x engineers (Redwood) available for the rehearsal: one to trigger failover, one to monitor KV cache behavior.
- Pre-provisioned test listing (non-production) to avoid metadata changes during the demo.
- Recording capture via our streaming endpoint; will share upload link post-call.

I've attached the handoff-checklist.xlsx with roles and run steps. Lauren / Vanessa: I recommend the overnight bracket if Siemens wants an exhaustive rehearsal; otherwise Fri 16:30 CEST is fine for a polished buyer-facing run.

Karthik

--
Karthik Iyer
SI Enablement, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
From: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
To: Devon Park <devon.park@siemens-cloud.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, olga_petrov@redwood.com, marketplace-ops@siemens-cloud.com
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Siemens x Redwood — co-sell demo window request

Devon / Sara — thanks for the quick turnaround. Based on ops input, we recommend the overnight bracket Thu 20 May 23:00–01:00 CEST to include a full SI dry-run and the failover rehearsal. Action items:

1) Devon/Sara: confirm attendees and who owns marketplace metadata by EOD Mon 17:00 CEST (we need the fields populated).
2) Vanessa: will run the buyer-facing first 30m and own recording upload.
3) Karthik/Olga: run the failover rehearsal and validate the mirror in eu-west-1 (Karthik to provision).
4) Lauren: I'll publish the final runbook and calendar invite once Devon confirms attendee list.

If Devon prefers Fri 16:30, let us know by EOD today and we'll compress the agenda. Otherwise we'll send invites for Thu night and the dry-run pre-call for engineers 60 minutes prior.

Thanks — Lauren

--
Lauren Bishop
Partnerships Lead, Redwood Inference
